name: A Cosmic Match
source:
It's Sweethearts Day and you have a flight to catch, but the thrum of excitement emanating from a divey, colony-side tavern is irresistible. Step inside and you'll discover more than good drinks: money owed, dangerously smooth banter, bounty hunting action, and a potential new flame! 

[Source: In-App Description]
translation:
今天是甜心节，你还得赶上一班飞船，可殖民地边上一间破旧酒馆里传来的热闹气氛，实在让人难以抗拒。走进去，你将发现的远不止美酒。有待偿还的债务、圆滑得危险的调情、赏金猎人的行动，以及一段可能萌芽的新恋情！

[来源为应用内简介]
